description: Queues a crawl audit of the property's own site in Organiq (HTML pages inside the verified property, robots.txt respected). Answers status "queued", or "not_queued" with reason "already_open" (an audit is queued or running) or "recent" (the last audit finished less than 24 hours ago), with the date of the last audit. The audit finishes within minutes to some hours depending on site size; read the result with get_site_audit. Writes only to Organiq, never to the audited site, Search Console, GA4 or Bing. Needs the write scope (mcp:write). Use it when get_site_audit reports no audit yet or the user fixed issues and wants a new reading. / Põe uma auditoria do site na fila; recusa se já há uma aberta ou se a última tem menos de 24 h.

site.description: Property: displayName ("example.com"), Search Console siteUrl ("sc-domain:example.com", "https://www.example.com/") or numeric id. A unique substring among visible properties also works ("exam"). list_sites shows the options. The value "demo" selects a demonstration site with fictional data: it works without signing in and is read-only. / Propriedade por nome, siteUrl ou id; "demo" é um site de demonstração com dados fictícios, sem login e só leitura.

name: request_site_audit
